cast.name: KNC Jar
cast.description: The talking DERMDOC 2% Kojic Acid Night Cream jar (cobalt-blue base, white lid, small cartoon eyes, mouth, tiny arms and legs). Warm, caring, playful team-boss voice that tucks the woman in and introduces its night team; bright mid-high pitch (~265 Hz).

cast.name: Kojic Acid
cast.description: Golden molecular Kojic Acid hero with a tiny precision scanner/magnifier, targets individual dark spots. Male-coded (Hindi 'karta hoon'): confident, smart, slightly cocky action-hero voice; should sound deeper than the two female ingredients.

cast.name: Niacinamide
cast.description: Pearly silver-white molecular Niacinamide heroine with a glow-diffusion wand, works on dullness. Female-coded ('karti hoon'): calm, polished, elegant and cheerful, premium not childish (~255 Hz).

cast.name: Alpha Arbutin
cast.description: Polished soft-pink droplet Alpha Arbutin heroine with a tiny tone-balancing tool, evens out uneven tone. Female-coded: sweet, gentle, a little sing-song, the lightest and brightest voice of the team.

lines.speaker: kojic_jar
lines.en: You go to sleep. My night team is clocking in.
lines.bn: তুমি ঘুমোও, আমার নাইট টিম কাজে।
lines.or: ତୁମେ ଶୋଇପଡ଼, ମୋ ନାଇଟ ଟିମ କାମରେ।

lines.speaker: kojic_acid
lines.en: I'm two percent Kojic Acid. I work on the look of dark spots and pigmentation.
lines.bn: আমি টু পারসেন্ট কোজিক অ্যাসিড, টার্গেট ডার্ক স্পট, পিগমেন্টেশন।
lines.ta: நான் டூ பர்சென்ட் கோஜிக் ஆசிட். டார்க் ஸ்பாட், பிக்மென்டேஷன் என் வேலை.
lines.te: నేను టూ పర్సెంట్ కోజిక్ యాసిడ్. డార్క్ స్పాట్, పిగ్మెంటేషన్ నా పని.
lines.ml: ഞാൻ ടു പെർസന്റ് കോജിക് ആസിഡ്. ഡാർക്ക് സ്പോട്ട്, പിഗ്മെന്റേഷൻ എന്റെ പണി.
lines.or: ମୁଁ ଟୁ ପର୍ସେଣ୍ଟ କୋଜିକ ଏସିଡ, ଟାର୍ଗେଟ ଡାର୍କ ସ୍ପଟ, ପିଗମେଣ୍ଟେସନ।

lines.speaker: niacinamide
lines.en: I help make dull-looking skin look brighter.
lines.or: ମୁଁ ଡଲ ସ୍କିନକୁ ବ୍ରାଇଟ ଲୁକ ଦିଏ।

lines.speaker: alpha_arbutin
lines.en: And I help even out uneven-looking tone.

lines.speaker: kojic_jar
lines.en: Rich night cream. Apply, let it absorb, and stay consistent. DERMDOC two percent Kojic Acid Night Cream.
lines.bn: রিচ ক্রিম। লাগাও, মিশুক, রোজ লাগাও। ডার্মডক টু পারসেন্ট কোজিক অ্যাসিড নাইট ক্রিম।
lines.ta: ரிச் க்ரீம். தடவு, ஊறட்டும், தினமும். டெர்ம்டாக் டூ பர்சென்ட் கோஜிக் ஆசிட் நைட் க்ரீம்.
lines.te: రిచ్ క్రీమ్. రాసుకో, ఇంకనీ, రోజూ వాడు. డెర్మ్‌డాక్ టూ పర్సెంట్ కోజిక్ యాసిడ్ నైట్ క్రీమ్.
lines.ml: റിച്ച് ക്രീം. പുരട്ടൂ, ഇറങ്ങട്ടെ, ഡെയ്ലി. ഡെർമ്ഡോക് ടു പെർസന്റ് കോജിക് ആസിഡ് നൈറ്റ് ക്രീം.
lines.or: ରିଚ କ୍ରିମ। ଲଗାଅ, ମିଶୁ, ରୋଜ ଲଗାଅ। ଡର୍ମଡକ ଟୁ ପର୍ସେଣ୍ଟ କୋଜିକ ଏସିଡ ନାଇଟ କ୍ରିମ।

notes: Original audio is Hindi/Hinglish; video is 15.02 s (prompt timeline compressed from 20 s). Whisper segments are back-to-back with no gaps, so speaker boundaries are approximate (end > max_end by 0.04 s on lines 1-4 is just the contiguous segmentation). Whisper garbles: 'banane parti hoon' = 'banane mein support karti hoon' (Niacinamide); 'unwin looking mein port karti hoon' = 'uneven-looking tone mein support karti hoon' (Alpha Arbutin); 'Demdoc' = DERMDOC. Kojic Acid uses masculine Hindi verb ('karta hoon'), Niacinamide and Alpha Arbutin feminine ('karti hoon'), so Kojic is pitched -2 and the girls 0/+3 to keep the trio distinct even if the original used one generated voice. Per prompt the JAR speaks 'Rich night cream, apply, absorb and stay consistent' and the end-slate brand line; these two jar lines are merged into line 5 so the full product name fits the length budget. The 'Rich night cream' part was voiced noticeably lower in the original (~216 Hz vs ~265 Hz for the jar), so it is excluded from the jar ref_ranges to keep one consistent jar voice. No villains speak in this video.
